lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: Ah, travelers. Aldren has not seen new faces since the tremors began.

lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: Something stirs beneath the Mossy Cave to the north-east. My old key to the lower passage was lost there years ago.

lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: Cross the bridge east of the forest. And be careful.

lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: The Mossy Cave lies north-east, across the bridge. Find the old key.

lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: The old key! You found it.

lines.speaker: Elder Bram
lines.text: Then the lower passage can be opened... but that is a story yet to be written.

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Press Z to talk, X to close the menu, and Esc to open it!

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: My mom says monsters live in the tall grass. I only ever see slimes.

lines.speaker: Merchant
lines.text: Shop's not open yet. The economy hasn't been designed!
